description: This file implements server-side logic for managing invoice templates in a SvelteKit application. It includes loading templates with filters and pagination, as well as actions for creating, updating, and deleting invoice templates via API requests to a Django backend.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of invoice templates with optional search and pagination, transforming backend response to frontend structure.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new invoice template by sending a POST request with form data.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing invoice template specified by its ID, sending a PUT request with form data.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of an invoice template by its ID through a DELETE request.
